narrative.details:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
narrative.offerRewardText: Aye, this is the proof I asked for, and ye've done well, Theinn. I'm proud to be the first to offer my congratulations--and yer water totem. Use it wisely, and may fortune walk beside ye.Yer next trial won't come soon, so take this time to learn. Pure water heals, aye, but its gifts go far beyond mending wounds.
narrative.requestItemsText: How fared your journey to Westfall? Success there is hard to measure, but even small victories carry weight.
